name: Nyaung-U
tagline: The budget base with the airport and market
description: The main gateway town, home to Bagan's airport, the busy Mani Sithu market and the densest cluster of budget guesthouses and traveller restaurants. It is the practical, affordable place to base yourself, with the liveliest local buzz and the easiest access to SIMs, food and e-bike rentals.
bestFor: Budget travellers and longer, cost-conscious stays
pros: Cheapest rooms and food in the Bagan area
Airport, market and traveller amenities close by
Best selection of laptop-friendly cafes and SIM shops
cons: Furthest of the towns from the core temple cluster
Busier and dustier than the quieter areas

name: Old Bagan
tagline: Inside the archaeological zone, upscale and central
description: The historic heart, set within the walled archaeological zone amid many of the most famous temples. Accommodation here skews upscale, with the area's pricier hotels and riverside resorts. You wake surrounded by pagodas, but pay a premium and have fewer budget options and everyday services.
bestFor: Travellers wanting to stay among the temples
pros: Closest to the most iconic temples and sunrise spots
Unmatched atmosphere inside the heritage zone
cons: Most expensive area with few budget rooms
Fewer shops, cafes and everyday conveniences

name: New Bagan
tagline: The relocated town, mid-range and residential
description: Built when residents were moved from Old Bagan, this planned town sits at the plain's southern edge. It offers a mid-range mix of guesthouses, small hotels and restaurants in a calmer, more residential setting, still within easy e-bike reach of the southern temples and sunset viewpoints.
bestFor: Mid-budget stays wanting quiet and convenience
pros: Good balance of price, comfort and quiet
Close to southern temples and sunset points
More local, residential feel than the tourist strips
cons: Less lively than Nyaung-U in the evenings

name: Irrawaddy Riverside and Temple-Plain Viewpoints
tagline: Sunrise, sunset and slow river views
description: Not a town but the scenic belt along the Irrawaddy and the open plain, where the finest sunrise and sunset viewpoints, riverside terraces and balloon-launch fields lie. A scattering of upscale riverside hotels sits here, but its real draw is the views, the boats and the wide, glowing horizons.
bestFor: Photographers and sunrise or sunset chasers
pros: The best sunrise, sunset and balloon views
Peaceful riverside settings and slow-boat access
Direct immersion in the temple-plain landscape
cons: Spread out, with few services and little nightlife
Upscale riverside stays can be costly
